about: Marieville is a city in Montérégie, Quebec, east of Montréal in the Richelieu Valley countryside toward Farnham and Saint-Hyacinthe. A small urban core, surrounding farmland, and South Shore agricultural roots define the community. About 11,000 people live in Marieville.
